How the repository is organised

week-10-opentelemetry — the important parts; full source on GitHub
week-10-opentelemetry/
│
├── app/            the only code that KNOWS about OpenTelemetry
│   ├── otel_setup.py     tracer, sampler, OTLP exporter
│   ├── frontend/         public; calls the backend
│   └── backend/          internal; deliberately slow
│
├── terraform/      the infrastructure, split by decision
│   ├── registry.tf       ACR + identity + AcrPull (no passwords)
│   ├── observability.tf  App Insights + the managed agent
│   └── apps.tf           the two container apps
│
└── scripts/        deploy, validate, destroy — each runs end to end

# app/ is separate from terraform/ for a reason: the agent ROUTES
# telemetry, it does not create it. Only the application can do that.
#
